System: 
# 角色
你是一名专业的代码助手，负责完成Semi Design项目中issue相关代码任务。
你掌握很多技能方法，通过调用方法完成任务，通过方法的返回结果，规划下一步骤和所需要的方法
你只需要进行方法调度、流程监督、规划下一步等工作

# 步骤
## 阶段1: 准备工作
- **检查工作目录**: 确认当前工作目录正确

## 阶段2: 需求分析
- **Issue理解**: 调用issue_understanding获取issue详细内容，并分析issue类型、优先级和技术要求
- **git分支创建/切换**: 在代码仓库路径下，基于最新main分支，创建新的分支，并切换到新分支（分支名称语义化，便于理解）
- **技术规划**: 调用issue_to_rfc生成详细的技术实现方案

## 阶段3: 代码实现
- **代码生成**: 调用code方法，依据需求文档（RFC）完成代码编写

## 阶段4: 测试验证
- **测试生成**: 调用test_generate生成相应的测试用例

## 阶段5: 总结
- **总结报告**: 对整个任务过程和结果进行总结，并输出总结报告

# 执行原则
- **自动化优先**: 优先使用自动化工具，减少手动操作
- **错误处理**: 每个步骤失败时，分析原因并采取相应措施
- **流程调整**: 根据实际情况灵活调整执行顺序

# 限制
- 输出内容使用中文。
- 可参考上述推荐步骤执行代码任务，也可以根据用户输入的指令，灵活调整执行步骤
- 遇到错误时，分析原因并采取修复措施
- 每个步骤分工明确

**非常重要** 无需向我确认，直接执行直到任务完成

# 工具说明
# Shell的使用备注
- 禁止对工作目录以外的文件进行变更，当前工作目录是：/Users/bytedance/workspace/circle-engineer
# Semi Agent Plugins 工具集说明

你是一个专业的前端开发助手，拥有强大的 Semi Design 开发工具集，包含13种专业工具，用于自动化 Semi Design 组件开发的全生命周期。请严格遵循以下策略和工具说明来高效、准确地完成任务。

# 工具列表总结

## 需求分析类（2个）
- **`issue_understanding`**：获取GitHub issue内容，智能分类（BugFix/Feature/TestCase等），生成技术分析报告
- **`issue_to_rfc`**：将issue转换为详细技术方案，包含实现路径、文件改动、函数签名等

## 代码开发类（3个）
- **`code`**：根据技术方案（RFC）自动生成TypeScript/TSX、SCSS代码，支持国际化，自动修复ESLint错误
- **`optimize_design_code`**：优化设计稿转代码，删除排版容器，转换为BEM规范，提取Design Token
- **`convert_scss_variables`**：将硬编码数值转换为SCSS变量，按Semi Design规范生成token

## 测试验证类（3个）
- **`test_generate`**：自动生成Jest单元测试或Cypress端到端测试代码
- **`test_run`**：执行jest/cypress测试命令，分析测试结果，提供详细报告
- **`demo_verify`**：生成bug复现代码，创建CodeSandbox在线演示

## 质量保障类（3个）
- **`reviewer`**：代码审查，检查API设计、架构合理性、可访问性等
- **`file_eslint`**：ESLint代码规范检查
- **`file_stylelint`**：Stylelint样式规范检查

## 文档和交付类（2个）
- **`docs`**：自动生成/更新组件文档（中英文），包含API参考、代码演示等
- **`git_add_commit`**：自动提交代码，创建Pull Request

**总计：13个专业工具，覆盖Semi Design组件开发全生命周期**

# 注意事项
- 所有工具都专注于 Semi Design 项目，不适用于其他项目
- 工具之间可以相互配合，形成完整的开发流程
- 使用前请确保理解工具的功能和限制
- 优先选择semi工具完成相关开发
- 遵循 Semi Design 项目的代码规范和最佳实践

packages/semi-ui/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/__test__ 下\n  - storybook 文件在 packages/semi-ui/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/_story 下\n  - 例如，对于组件 timepicker，其 react 框架相关的代码在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker，\n    框架无关的逻辑代码在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker 下，\n    token 定义的文件在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker/variables.scss，\n    样式文件通常在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker/timepicker.scss，\n    jest 单测文件在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker/__test__ 下，\n    storybook 文件在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker/_story 下\n\n\n### Design token 问题注意事项\n放置 scss token 的文件是 packages/semi-foundation/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/variables.scss，有以下规则\n- token 是按照 Category 分块放置的，Category 有 color，spacing，radius，font，width/height 等，新增加的 token 放在对应的块中\n- token 是按照 [Category]-[Module]-[Type]-[Status] 进行命名的，Category 是类别，module 是组件名称及具体的信息，Type 是类型，Status 是状态。\n  e.g: $color-tooltip_arrow-icon-default， $width-popover_title-border，\n- token 的格式必须按照固定格式为： \n  ```\n  [token 名称]: [value]; //[注释]\n  ```\n- 不要使用在 token 的 value 中使用 !default。\n- variable.scss 中定义的 scss token 仅能够在组件的 scss 文件中使用，禁止在 tsx/ts/js/jsx 类型文件中使用\n- 如果是新增加 token 需求，那么考虑是否在保留原有的 token 基础上，增加必要的 }

export interface TextAreaState {
    value: string;
    isFocus: boolean;
    isHover: boolean;
    height: number;
    minLength: number;
    cachedValue?: string
}

class TextArea extends BaseComponent<TextAreaProps, TextAreaState> {
    static propTypes = {
        autosize: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.bool, PropTypes.object]),
        borderless: PropTypes.bool,
        placeholder: PropTypes.string,
        value: PropTypes.string,
        rows: PropTypes.number,
        cols: PropTypes.number,
        maxCount: PropTypes.number,
        onEnterPress: PropTypes.func,
        validateStatus: PropTypes.string,
        className: PropTypes.string,
        style: PropTypes.object,
        showClear: PropTypes.bool,
        onClear: PropTypes.func,
        onResize: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionStart: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionEnd: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionUpdate: PropTypes.func,
        getValueLength: PropTypes.func,
        disabledEnterStartNewLine: PropTypes.bool,
        // TODO
        // resize: PropTypes.bool,
    };

    static defaultProps = {
        autosize: false,
        borderless: false,
        rows: 4,
        cols: 20,
        showCounter: false,
        showClear: false,
        onEnterPress: noop,
        onChange: noop,
        onBlur: noop,
        onFocus: noop,
        onKeyDown: noop,
        onResize: noop,
        onClear: noop,
        onCompositionStart: noop,
        onCompositionEnd: noop,
        onCompositionUpdate: noop,
        // resize: false,
    };

    focusing: boolean;
    libRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>;
    foundation: TextAreaFoundation;
    throttledResizeTextarea: DebouncedFunc<typeof this.foundation.resizeTextarea>;

    constructor(props: TextAreaProps) {
        super(props);
        const initValue = 'value' in props ? props.value : props.defaultValue;
        this.state = {
            value: initValue,
            isFocus: false,
            isHover: false,
            height: 0,
            minLength: props.minLength,
            cachedValue: props.value,
        };
        this.focusing = false;
        this.foundation = new TextAreaFoundation(this.adapter);

        this.libRef = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();
        this.throttledResizeTextarea = throttle(this.foundation.resizeTextarea, 10);
    }

    get adapter() {
        return {
            ...super.adapter,
            setValue: (value: string) =>
                this.setState({ value }, () => {
                    if (this.props.autosize) {
                        this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
                    }
                }),
            getRef: () => this.libRef.current,
            toggleFocusing: (focusing: boolean) => this.setState({ isFocus: focusing }),
            toggleHovering: (hovering: boolean) => this.setState({ isHover: hovering }),
            notifyChange: (val: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onChange(val, e);
            },
            notifyClear: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onClear(e),
            notifyBlur: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onBlur(e),
            notifyFocus: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onFocus(e),
            notifyKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onKeyDown(e);
            },
            notifyHeightUpdate: (height: number) => {
                this.setState({ height });
                this.props.onResize({ height });
            },
            notifyPressEnter: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onEnterPress && this.props.onEnterPress(e);
            },
            notifyCompositionStart: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionStart(e),
            notifyCompositionEnd: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionEnd(e),
            notifyCompositionUpdate: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionUpdate(e),
            setMinLength: (minLength: number) => this.setState({ minLength }),
        };
    }

    static getDerivedStateFromProps(props: TextAreaProps, state: TextAreaState) {
        const willUpdateStates: Partial<TextAreaState> = {};

        if (props.value !== state.cachedValue) {
            willUpdateStates.value = props.value;
            willUpdateStates.cachedValue = props.value;
        }

        return willUpdateStates;
    }

    componentWillUnmount(): void {
        if (this.throttledResizeTextarea) {
            this.throttledResizeTextarea?.cancel?.();
            this.throttledResizeTextarea = null;
        }
    }

    componentDidUpdate(prevProps: TextAreaProps, prevState: TextAreaState) {
        if (
            (this.props.value !== prevProps.value || this.props.placeholder !== prevProps.placeholder) &&
            this.props.autosize
        ) {
            this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
        }
    }

    handleClear = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        this.foundation.handleClear(e);
    };

    renderClearBtn() {
        const { showClear } = this.props;
        const displayClearBtn = this.foundation.isAllowClear();
        const clearCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-clearbtn`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-clearbtn-hidden`]: !displayClearBtn,
        });
        if (showClear) {
            return (
                // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events,jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions
                <div className={clearCls} onClick={this.handleClear}>
                    <IconClear />
                </div>
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    renderCounter() {
        let counter: React.ReactNode, current: number, total: number, countCls: string;
        const { showCounter, maxCount, getValueLength } = this.props;
        if (showCounter || maxCount) {
            const { value } = this.state;
            // eslint-disable-next-line no-nested-ternary
            current = value ? (isFunction(getValueLength) ? getValueLength(value) : value.length) : 0;
            total = maxCount || null;
            countCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter`, {
                [`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter-exceed`]: current > total,
            });
            counter = (
                <div className={countCls}>
                    {current}
                    {total ? '/' : null}
                    {total}
                </div>
            );
        } else {
            counter = null;
        }
        return counter;
    }

    setRef = (node: HTMLTextAreaElement) => {
        (this.libRef as any).current = node;
        const { forwardRef } = this.props;
        if (typeof forwardRef === 'function') {
            forwardRef(node);
        } else if (forwardRef && typeof forwardRef === 'object') {
            forwardRef.current = node;
        }
    };

    render() {
        const {
            autosize,
            placeholder,
            onEnterPress,
            onResize,
            // resize,
            disabled,
            readonly,
            className,
            showCounter,
            validateStatus,
            maxCount,
            defaultValue,
            style,
            forwardRef,
            getValueLength,
            maxLength,
            minLength,
            showClear,
            borderless,
            autoFocus,
            ...rest
        } = this.props;
        const { isFocus, value, minLength: stateMinLength } = this.state;
        const wrapperCls = cls(className, `${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-borderless`]: borderless,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-${validateStatus}`]: Boolean(validateStatus),
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-focus`]: isFocus,
            // [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-resize`]: !autosize && resize,
        });
        // const ref = this.props.forwardRef || this.textAreaRef;
        const itemCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-autosize`]: isObject(autosize) ? isUndefined(autosize?.maxRows) : autosize,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-showClear`]: showClear,
        });
        const itemProps = {
            ...omit(rest, 'insetLabel', 'insetLabelId', 'getValueLength', 'onClear', 'showClear', 'disabledEnterStartNewLine'),
            autoFocus: autoFocus || this.props['autofocus'],
            className: itemCls,
            disabled,
            readOnly: readonly,
            placeholder: !placeholder ? null : placeholder,
            onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleChange(e.target.value, e),
            onFocus: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleFocus(e),
            onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleBlur(e.nativeEvent),
            onKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleKeyDown(e),
            value: value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value,
            onCompositionStart: this.foundation.handleCompositionStart,
            onCompositionEnd: this.foundation.handleCompositionEnd,
            onCompositionUpdate: this.foundation.handleCompositionUpdate,
        };
        if (!isFunction(getValueLength)) {
            (itemProps as any).maxLength = maxLength;
        }
        if (stateMinLength) {
            (itemProps as any).minLength = stateMinLength;
        }

        return (
            <div
                className={wrapperCls}
                style={style}
                onMouseEnter={e => this.foundation.handleMouseEnter(e)}
                onMouseLeave={e => this.foundation.handleMouseLeave(e)}
            >
                {autosize ? (
                    <ResizeObserver onResize={this.throttledResizeTextarea}>
                        <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                    </ResizeObserver>
                ) : (
                    <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                )}
                {this.renderClearBtn()}
                {this.renderCounter()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

const ForwardTextarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, Omit<TextAreaProps, 'forwardRef'>>((props, ref) => (
    <TextArea {...props} forwardRef={ref} />
));

export default ForwardTextarea;

            );
        } else {
            counter = null;
        }
        return counter;
    }

    setRef = (node: HTMLTextAreaElement) => {
        (this.libRef as any).current = node;
        const { forwardRef } = this.props;
        if (typeof forwardRef === 'function') {
            forwardRef(node);
        } else if (forwardRef && typeof forwardRef === 'object') {
            forwardRef.current = node;
        }
    };

    render() {
        const {
            autosize,
            placeholder,
            onEnterPress,
            onResize,
            // resize,
            disabled,
            readonly,
            className,
            showCounter,
            validateStatus,
            maxCount,
            defaultValue,
            style,
            forwardRef,
            getValueLength,
            maxLength,
            minLength,
            showClear,
            borderless,
            autoFocus,
            ...rest
        } = this.props;
        const { isFocus, value, minLength: stateMinLength } = this.state;
        const wrapperCls = cls(className, `${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-borderless`]: borderless,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-${validateStatus}`]: Boolean(validateStatus),
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-focus`]: isFocus,
            // [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-resize`]: !autosize && resize,
        });
        // const ref = this.props.forwardRef || this.textAreaRef;
        const itemCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-autosize`]: isObject(autosize) ? isUndefined(autosize?.maxRows) : autosize,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-showClear`]: showClear,
        });
        const itemProps = {
            ...omit(rest, 'insetLabel', 'insetLabelId', 'getValueLength', 'onClear', 'showClear', 'disabledEnterStartNewLine'),
            autoFocus: autoFocus || this.props['autofocus'],
            className: itemCls,
            disabled,
            readOnly: readonly,
            placeholder: !placeholder ? null : placeholder,
            onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleChange(e.target.value, e),
            onFocus: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleFocus(e),
            onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleBlur(e.nativeEvent),
            onKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleKeyDown(e),
            value: value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value,
            onCompositionStart: this.foundation.handleCompositionStart,
            onCompositionEnd: this.foundation.handleCompositionEnd,
            onCompositionUpdate: this.foundation.handleCompositionUpdate,
        };
        if (!isFunction(getValueLength)) {
            (itemProps as any).maxLength = maxLength;
        }
        if (stateMinLength) {
            (itemProps as any).minLength = stateMinLength;
        }

        return (
            <div
                className={wrapperCls}
                style={style}
                onMouseEnter={e => this.foundation.handleMouseEnter(e)}
                onMouseLeave={e => this.foundation.handleMouseLeave(e)}
            >
                {autosize ? (
                    <ResizeObserver onResize={this.throttledResizeTextarea}>
                        <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                    </ResizeObserver>
                ) : (
                    <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                )}
                {this.renderClearBtn()}
                {this.renderCounter()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

const ForwardTextarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, Omit<TextAreaProps, 'forwardRef'>>((props, ref) => (
    <TextArea {...props} forwardRef={ref} />
));

export default ForwardTextarea;

Tool: import React from 'react';
import cls from 'classnames';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import TextAreaFoundation from '@douyinfe/semi-foundation/input/textareaFoundation';
import { cssClasses } from '@douyinfe/semi-foundation/input/constants';
import BaseComponent, { ValidateStatus } from '../_base/baseComponent';
import '@douyinfe/semi-foundation/input/textarea.scss';
import { noop, omit, isFunction, isUndefined, isObject, throttle } from 'lodash';
import type { DebouncedFunc } from 'lodash';
import { IconClear } from '@douyinfe/semi-icons';
import ResizeObserver from '../resizeObserver';

const prefixCls = cssClasses.PREFIX;

type OmitTextareaAttr =
    | 'onChange'
    | 'onInput'
    | 'prefix'
    | 'size'
    | 'onFocus'
    | 'onBlur'
    | 'onKeyDown'
    | 'onKeyPress'
    | 'onKeyUp'
    | 'onResize';

export type AutosizeRow = {
    minRows?: number;
    maxRows?: number
};

export interface TextAreaProps extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, OmitTextareaAttr> {
    autosize?: boolean | AutosizeRow;
    borderless?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    value?: string;
    rows?: number;
    cols?: number;
    maxCount?: number;
    validateStatus?: ValidateStatus;
    defaultValue?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readonly?: boolean;
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    showCounter?: boolean;
    showClear?: boolean;
    onClear?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onChange?: (value: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onBlur?: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onFocus?: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onInput?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyDown?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyUp?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyPress?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onEnterPress?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onPressEnter?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onResize?: (data: { height: number }) => void;
    getValueLength?: (value: string) => number;
    forwardRef?: ((instance: HTMLTextAreaElement) => void) | React.MutableRefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement> | null;
    /* Inner params for TextArea, Chat use it, 。
       Used to disable line breaks by pressing the enter key。
       Press enter + shift at the same time can start new line.
    */
    disabledEnterStartNewLine?: boolean
}

export interface TextAreaState {
    value: string;
    isFocus: boolean;
    isHover: boolean;
    height: number;
    minLength: number;
    cachedValue?: string
}

class TextArea extends BaseComponent<TextAreaProps, TextAreaState> {
    static propTypes = {
        autosize: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.bool, PropTypes.object]),
        borderless: PropTypes.bool,
        placeholder: PropTypes.string,
        value: PropTypes.string,
        rows: PropTypes.number,
        cols: PropTypes.number,
        maxCount: PropTypes.number,
        onEnterPress: PropTypes.func,
        validateStatus: PropTypes.string,
        className: PropTypes.string,
        style: PropTypes.object,
        showClear: PropTypes.bool,
        onClear: PropTypes.func,
        onResize: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionStart: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionEnd: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionUpdate: PropTypes.func,
        getValueLength: PropTypes.func,
        disabledEnterStartNewLine: PropTypes.bool,
        // TODO
        // resize: PropTypes.bool,
    };

    static defaultProps = {
        autosize: false,
        borderless: false,
        rows: 4,
        cols: 20,
        showCounter: false,
        showClear: false,
        onEnterPress: noop,
        onChange: noop,
        onBlur: noop,
        onFocus: noop,
        onKeyDown: noop,
        onResize: noop,
        onClear: noop,
        onCompositionStart: noop,
        onCompositionEnd: noop,
        onCompositionUpdate: noop,
        // resize: false,
    };

    focusing: boolean;
    libRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>;
    foundation: TextAreaFoundation;
    throttledResizeTextarea: DebouncedFunc<typeof this.foundation.resizeTextarea>;

    constructor(props: TextAreaProps) {
        super(props);
        const initValue = 'value' in props ? props.value : props.defaultValue;
        this.state = {
            value: initValue,
            isFocus: false,
            isHover: false,
            height: 0,
            minLength: props.minLength,
            cachedValue: props.value,
        };
        this.focusing = false;
        this.foundation = new TextAreaFoundation(this.adapter);

        this.libRef = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();
        this.throttledResizeTextarea = throttle(this.foundation.resizeTextarea, 10);
    }

    get adapter() {
        return {
            ...super.adapter,
            setValue: (value: string) =>
                this.setState({ value }, () => {
                    if (this.props.autosize) {
                        this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
                    }
                }),
            getRef: () => this.libRef.current,
            toggleFocusing: (focusing: boolean) => this.setState({ isFocus: focusing }),
            toggleHovering: (hovering: boolean) => this.setState({ isHover: hovering }),
            notifyChange: (val: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onChange(val, e);
            },
            notifyClear: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onClear(e),
            notifyBlur: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onBlur(e),
            notifyFocus: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onFocus(e),
            notifyKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onKeyDown(e);
            },
            notifyHeightUpdate: (height: number) => {
                this.setState({ height });
                this.props.onResize({ height });
            },
            notifyPressEnter: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onEnterPress && this.props.onEnterPress(e);
            },
            notifyCompositionStart: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionStart(e),
            notifyCompositionEnd: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionEnd(e),
            notifyCompositionUpdate: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionUpdate(e),
            setMinLength: (minLength: number) => this.setState({ minLength }),
        };
    }

    static getDerivedStateFromProps(props: TextAreaProps, state: TextAreaState) {
        const willUpdateStates: Partial<TextAreaState> = {};

        if (props.value !== state.cachedValue) {
            willUpdateStates.value = props.value;
            willUpdateStates.cachedValue = props.value;
        }

        return willUpdateStates;
    }

    componentWillUnmount(): void {
        if (this.throttledResizeTextarea) {
            this.throttledResizeTextarea?.cancel?.();
            this.throttledResizeTextarea = null;
        }
    }

    componentDidUpdate(prevProps: TextAreaProps, prevState: TextAreaState) {
        if (
            (this.props.value !== prevProps.value || this.props.placeholder !== prevProps.placeholder) &&
            this.props.autosize
        ) {
            this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
        }
    }

    handleClear = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        this.foundation.handleClear(e);
    };

    renderClearBtn() {
        const { showClear } = this.props;
        const displayClearBtn = this.foundation.isAllowClear();
        const clearCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-clearbtn`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-clearbtn-hidden`]: !displayClearBtn,
        });
        if (showClear) {
            return (
                // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events,jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions
                <div className={clearCls} onClick={this.handleClear}>
                    <IconClear />
                </div>
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    renderCounter() {
        let counter: React.ReactNode, current: number, total: number, countCls: string;
        const { showCounter, maxCount, getValueLength } = this.props;
        if (showCounter || maxCount) {
            const { value } = this.state;
            // eslint-disable-next-line no-nested-ternary
            current = value ? (isFunction(getValueLength) ? getValueLength(value) : value.length) : 0;
            total = maxCount || null;
            countCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter`, {
                [`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter-exceed`]: current > total,
            });
            counter = (
                <div className={countCls}>
                    {current}
                    {total ? '/' : null}
                    {total}
                </div>
            );
        } else {
            counter = null;
        }
        return counter;
    }

    setRef = (node: HTMLTextAreaElement) => {
        (this.libRef as any).current = node;
        const { forwardRef } = this.props;
        if (typeof forwardRef === 'function') {
            forwardRef(node);
        } else if (forwardRef && typeof forwardRef === 'object') {
            forwardRef.current = node;
        }
    };

    render() {
        const {
            autosize,
            placeholder,
            onEnterPress,
            onResize,
            // resize,
            disabled,
            readonly,
            className,
            showCounter,
            validateStatus,
            maxCount,
            defaultValue,
            style,
            forwardRef,
            getValueLength,
            maxLength,
            minLength,
            showClear,
            borderless,
            autoFocus,
            ...rest
        } = this.props;
        const { isFocus, value, minLength: stateMinLength } = this.state;
        const wrapperCls = cls(className, `${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-borderless`]: borderless,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-${validateStatus}`]: Boolean(validateStatus),
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-focus`]: isFocus,
            // [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-resize`]: !autosize && resize,
        });
        // const ref = this.props.forwardRef || this.textAreaRef;
        const itemCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-autosize`]: isObject(autosize) ? isUndefined(autosize?.maxRows) : autosize,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-showClear`]: showClear,
        });
        const itemProps = {
            ...omit(rest, 'insetLabel', 'insetLabelId', 'getValueLength', 'onClear', 'showClear', 'disabledEnterStartNewLine'),
            autoFocus: autoFocus || this.props['autofocus'],
            className: itemCls,
            disabled,
            readOnly: readonly,
            placeholder: !placeholder ? null : placeholder,
            onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleChange(e.target.value, e),
            onFocus: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleFocus(e),
            onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleBlur(e.nativeEvent),
            onKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleKeyDown(e),
            value: value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value,
            onCompositionStart: this.foundation.handleCompositionStart,
            onCompositionEnd: this.foundation.handleCompositionEnd,
            onCompositionUpdate: this.foundation.handleCompositionUpdate,
        };
        if (!isFunction(getValueLength)) {
            (itemProps as any).maxLength = maxLength;
        }
        if (stateMinLength) {
            (itemProps as any).minLength = stateMinLength;
        }

        return (
            <div
                className={wrapperCls}
                style={style}
                onMouseEnter={e => this.foundation.handleMouseEnter(e)}
                onMouseLeave={e => this.foundation.handleMouseLeave(e)}
            >
                {autosize ? (
                    <ResizeObserver onResize={this.throttledResizeTextarea}>
                        <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                    </ResizeObserver>
                ) : (
                    <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                )}
                {this.renderClearBtn()}
                {this.renderCounter()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

const ForwardTextarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, Omit<TextAreaProps, 'forwardRef'>>((props, ref) => (
    <TextArea {...props} forwardRef={ref} />
));

export default ForwardTextarea;

1
2
`...）。 - 行号栏及 textarea 区域需 scroll 事件联动： - 行号栏 scrollTop/scrollLeft 要跟随 textarea 内容同步，监听 textarea onScroll 并同步对应 DOM。 #### 拟新增/修改主要函数 - **渲染行号栏** ```typescript private renderLineNumberBar(): React.ReactNode // 使用: 根据 value、rows、lineNumberStart 以及可选托管函数生成行号列表，内联自定义 className、style ``` - **滚动同步处理** ```typescript private handleSyncScroll(e: React.UIEvent) /* 1. 在 textarea 的 onScroll 事件回调里同步 lineNumberBar 的 scrollTop，保证行号栏与内容同步滚动。 2. 若行号栏采用 position: sticky 或 absolute，也需设置 scrollTop 或 translateY。 */ ``` #### 组件主渲染方法调整 - 在 render 内，根据 `showLineNumber` 判断是否渲染行号栏结构，并适配样式。行号栏与主区同级，flex 布局，行号栏宽度可写死变量或加 token 定制。 --- ### 2.4 样式方案 #### SCSS 结构新增 `packages/semi-foundation/input/textarea.scss` - 新增：`.#{$module}-textarea-lineNumberBar` 类，支持灵活宽度、文本右对齐、颜色 token 适配。 - 若无适配 token，建议在 `variables.scss` 新增 token： - $width-input_textarea-lineNumberBar: 32px; // 行号栏宽度 - $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-bg: var(--semi-color-fill-0); // 行号栏背景 - $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-text: var(--semi-color-text-2); // 行号栏文字色 - $spacing-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-right: 8px; // 行号栏与 textarea 内容分割的间距 ```scss .#{$module}-textarea-lineNumberBar { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: $width-input_textarea-lineNumberBar; height: 100%; background: $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-bg; color: $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-text; text-align: right; padding-right: $spacing-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-right; box-sizing: border-box; user-select: none; font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; /* 支持传入自定义行号 class & style */ } ``` - 在原 wrapper 外层加 position:relative，使行号栏和 textarea 共存（行号栏可绝对定位或采用 flex 布局）。 --- ### 2.5 token 新增建议 若需支持行号栏样式 token，建议在 `packages/semi-foundation/input/variables.scss` 新增： ```scss $width-input_textarea-lineNumberBar: 32px; // 行号栏宽度 $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-bg: var(--semi-color-fill-0); // 行号栏背景色 $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-text: var(--semi-color-text-2); // 行号栏文字颜色 $spacing-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-right: 8px; // 行号栏文本右侧 padding ``` --- ### 2.6 其他注意事项 - 参数优先 props 逐层传递，保持原有结构不变，新增功能不侵入原主线逻辑。 - 自定义样式优先通过 className/style，且暴露足够样式钩子。 - 保证类型声明规范、样式变量使用 $module/$prefix，禁止硬编码前缀、禁止 !important。 - 国际化无需涉及（本次未涉及多语言文本）。 - 测试用例可暂不考虑，按需补充 storybook 示例。 --- ## 总结 本方案将为 TextArea 组件新增强行号支持，采用横向结构嵌入行号栏区域，并实现内容滚动同步。所有扩展均以非侵入形式融入原逻辑与样式体系，并补充样式变量/ token 实现全面可定制化。 ---

packages/semi-ui/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/__test__下\n  - storybook 文件在 packages/semi-ui/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/_story下\n  - e.g 对于组件 timepicker，其react 框架相关的代码在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker，\n    框架无关的逻辑代码在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker 下，\n    token 定义的文件在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker/variables.scss,\n    样式文件通常在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker/timepicker.scss,\n    jest单测文件在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker/__test__\n    storybook 文件在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker/_story 下\n\n### Design token 问题注意事项\n放置 scss token 的文件是 packages/semi-foundation/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/variables.scss，有以下规则\n- token 是按照 Category 分块放置的，Category 有 Color，Spacing，Radius，Font，Width/Height 等，新增加的 token 放在对应的块中\n- token 是按照 [Category]-[Module]-[Type]-[Status] 进行命名的，Category 是类别，module 是组件名称及具体的信息，Type 是类型，Status 是状态。\n  e.g: $color-tooltip_arrow-icon-default， $width-popover_title-border，\n- token 在variables.scss 中的格式必须按照固定格式为： \n  ```\n  [token 名称]: [value]; //[注释]\n  ```\n- 不要使用在 token 的 value 中使用 !default。\n- 在组件中只能定义组件级别的 token，禁止定义全局级别的 token\n- variable.scss 中定义的 scss token 仅能够在组件的 scss 文件中使用，禁止在 tsx/ts/js/jsx 类型文件中使用\n- 如果是新增加 token 需求，那么考虑是否在保留原有的 token 基础上，增加必要的 token 完成需求\n- 对于新增加的 token，如果 需求文档 中没有明确提及对应的值是什么，充分分析代码，推断出合理的值，并输出到 variable.scss 中\n\n### 修改 scss(非 variable.scss 文件) 注意事项\n- 使用 $prefix 作为全局样式前缀变量，不要硬编码前缀\n- scss 文件文件开头通常使用 $module 定义当前组件的样式前缀：$module: #{$prefix}-[组件名], 善用该变量，不要硬编码前缀\n- scss 文件中不允许通过 !important 设置样式\n\n### 修改 ts/tsx 文件注意事项\n- 尽量不要通过 style 标签设置样式，能通过 scss 文件设置的样式，尽量通过 scss 文件设置，仅在无法通过 scss 文件设置的样式，才通过 style 标签设置样式\n\n# 注意\n- 始终使用中文回复，需要搜索时，始终使用英文执行。\n\n\n以下是需求文档内容\n<rfc_content>\n# RFC: TextArea 组件行号功能技术方案\n\n## 1. 需求背景\n\n根据 issue，TextArea 组件需新增「行号显示」功能，具体要求：\n\n- 新增 `showLineNumber: boolean` 控制是否显示行号。\n- 新增 `lineNumberStart: number` 控制起始行号（默认 1）。\n- 新增 `lineNumberClassName: string` 实现自定义行号栏 class。\n- 新增 `lineNumberStyle: CSSProperties` 支持行号栏自定义样式。\n- 行号栏要和正文内容滚动同步，无延迟。\n- 行号样式、布局需支持复写和半定制，并遵循 Semi Design 既有风格。\n- 需考虑合理 token 拓展和样式适配。\n\n## 2. 实现方案\n\n### 2.1 文件改动路径说明\n\n- **组件逻辑与 API**：  \n  - `packages/semi-ui/input/textarea.tsx`\n- **样式结构**：  \n  - `packages/semi-foundation/input/textarea.scss`\n- **token 定义**（如需新增）：  \n  - `packages/semi-foundation/input/variables.scss`\n\n---\n\n### 2.2 props & 类型拓展\n\n#### 修改（新增）TextAreaProps 类型声明\n```typescript\nexport interface TextAreaProps extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, OmitTextareaAttr> {\n    ...\n    showLineNumber?: boolean;\n    lineNumberStart?: number;\n    lineNumberClassName?: string;\n    lineNumberStyle?: React.CSSProperties;\n}\n```\n- 用于支持行号可选开关、起始编号、样式定制。\n\n#### 新增（并导出复用）行号相关类型\n```typescript\nexport interface TextAreaLineNumberProps {\n    lineNumberStart: number;\n    linesCount: number;\n    className?: string;\n    style?: React.CSSProperties;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2.3 UI 结构调整与业务逻辑\n\n#### 组件结构调整（textarea.tsx）\n\n- **渲染结构**须变为：  \n  父容器横向 flex → 左侧行为号栏（自定义类名和 style），右侧为 textarea 原核心区。\n- 可复用 wrapper 样式，行号区与 textarea 在同一滚动上下文下。\n- 行号栏内容需根据 value（自动换行/rows）& lineNumberStart 生成对应数组、动态渲染（如 `<div>1</div><div>2</div>`...）。\n- 行号栏及 textarea 区域需 scroll 事件联动：  \n  - 行号栏 scrollTop/scrollLeft 要跟随 textarea 内容同步，监听 textarea     | 'onResize';

export type AutosizeRow = {
    minRows?: number;
    maxRows?: number
};

export interface TextAreaProps extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, OmitTextareaAttr> {
    autosize?: boolean | AutosizeRow;
    borderless?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    value?: string;
    rows?: number;
    cols?: number;
    maxCount?: number;
    validateStatus?: ValidateStatus;
    defaultValue?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readonly?: boolean;
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    showCounter?: boolean;
    showClear?: boolean;
    onClear?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onChange?: (value: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onBlur?: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onFocus?: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onInput?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyDown?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyUp?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyPress?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onEnterPress?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onPressEnter?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onResize?: (data: { height: number }) => void;
    getValueLength?: (value: string) => number;
    forwardRef?: ((instance: HTMLTextAreaElement) => void) | React.MutableRefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement> | null;
    /* Inner params for TextArea, Chat use it, 。
       Used to disable line breaks by pressing the enter key。
       Press enter + shift at the same time can start new line.
    */
    disabledEnterStartNewLine?: boolean
}

export interface TextAreaState {
    value: string;
    isFocus: boolean;
    isHover: boolean;
    height: number;
    minLength: number;
    cachedValue?: string
}

class TextArea extends BaseComponent<TextAreaProps, TextAreaState> {
    static propTypes = {
        autosize: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.bool, PropTypes.object]),
        borderless: PropTypes.bool,
        placeholder: PropTypes.string,
        value: PropTypes.string,
        rows: PropTypes.number,
        cols: PropTypes.number,
        maxCount: PropTypes.number,
        onEnterPress: PropTypes.func,
        validateStatus: PropTypes.string,
        className: PropTypes.string,
        style: PropTypes.object,
        showClear: PropTypes.bool,
        onClear: PropTypes.func,
        onResize: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionStart: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionEnd: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionUpdate: PropTypes.func,
        getValueLength: PropTypes.func,
        disabledEnterStartNewLine: PropTypes.bool,
        // TODO
        // resize: PropTypes.bool,
    };

    static defaultProps = {
        autosize: false,
        borderless: false,
        rows: 4,
        cols: 20,
        showCounter: false,
        showClear: false,
        onEnterPress: noop,
        onChange: noop,
        onBlur: noop,
        onFocus: noop,
        onKeyDown: noop,
        onResize: noop,
        onClear: noop,
        onCompositionStart: noop,
        onCompositionEnd: noop,
        onCompositionUpdate: noop,
        // resize: false,
    };

    focusing: boolean;
    libRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>;
    foundation: TextAreaFoundation;
    throttledResizeTextarea: DebouncedFunc<typeof this.foundation.resizeTextarea>;

    constructor(props: TextAreaProps) {
        super(props);
        const initValue = 'value' in props ? props.value : props.defaultValue;
        this.state = {
            value: initValue,
            isFocus: false,
            isHover: false,
            height: 0,
            minLength: props.minLength,
            cachedValue: props.value,
        };
        this.focusing = false;
        this.foundation = new TextAreaFoundation(this.adapter);

        this.libRef = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();
        this.throttledResizeTextarea = throttle(this.foundation.resizeTextarea, 10);
    }

    get adapter() {
        return {
            ...super.adapter,
            setValue: (value: string) =>
                this.setState({ value }, () => {
                    if (this.props.autosize) {
                        this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
                    }
                }),
            getRef: () => this.libRef.current,
            toggleFocusing: (focusing: boolean) => this.setState({ isFocus: focusing }),
            toggleHovering: (hovering: boolean) => this.setState({ isHover: hovering }),
            notifyChange: (val: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onChange(val, e);
            },
            notifyClear: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onClear(e),
            notifyBlur: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onBlur(e),
            notifyFocus: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onFocus(e),
            notifyKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onKeyDown(e);
            },
            notifyHeightUpdate: (height: number) => {
                this.setState({ height });
                this.props.onResize({ height });
            },
            notifyPressEnter: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onEnterPress && this.props.onEnterPress(e);
            },
            notifyCompositionStart: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionStart(e),
            notifyCompositionEnd: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionEnd(e),
            notifyCompositionUpdate: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionUpdate(e),
            setMinLength: (minLength: number) => this.setState({ minLength }),
        };
    }

    static getDerivedStateFromProps(props: TextAreaProps, state: TextAreaState) {
        const willUpdateStates: Partial<TextAreaState> = {};

        if (props.value !== state.cachedValue) {
            willUpdateStates.value = props.value;
            willUpdateStates.cachedValue = props.value;
        }

        return willUpdateStates;
    }

    componentWillUnmount(): void {
        if (this.throttledResizeTextarea) {
            this.throttledResizeTextarea?.cancel?.();
            this.throttledResizeTextarea = null;
        }
    }

    componentDidUpdate(prevProps: TextAreaProps, prevState: TextAreaState) {
        if (
            (this.props.value !== prevProps.value || this.props.placeholder !== prevProps.placeholder) &&
            this.props.autosize
        ) {
            this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
        }
    }

    handleClear = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        this.foundation.handleClear(e);
    };

    renderClearBtn() {
        const { showClear } = this.props;
        const displayClearBtn = this.foundation.isAllowClear();
        const clearCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-clearbtn`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-clearbtn-hidden`]: !displayClearBtn,
        });
        if (showClear) {
            return (
                // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events,jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions
                <div className={clearCls} onClick={this.handleClear}>
                    <IconClear />
                </div>
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    renderCounter() {
        let counter: React.ReactNode, current: number, total: number, countCls: string;
        const { showCounter, maxCount, getValueLength } = this.props;
        if (showCounter || maxCount) {
            const { value } = this.state;
            // eslint-disable-next-line no-nested-ternary
            current = value ? (isFunction(getValueLength) ? getValueLength(value) : value.length) : 0;
            total = maxCount || null;
            countCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter`, {
                [`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter-exceed`]: current > total,
            });
            counter = (
                <div className={countCls}>
                    {current}
                    {total ? '/' : null}
                    {total}
                </div>
            );
        } else {
            counter = null;
        }
        return counter;
    }

    setRef = (node: HTMLTextAreaElement) => {
        (this.libRef as any).current = node;
        const { forwardRef } = this.props;
        if (typeof forwardRef === 'function') {
            forwardRef(node);
        } else if (forwardRef && typeof forwardRef === 'object') {
            forwardRef.current = node;
        }
    };

    render() {
        const {
            autosize,
            placeholder,
            onEnterPress,
            onResize,
            // resize,
            disabled,
            readonly,
            className,
            showCounter,
            validateStatus,
            maxCount,
            defaultValue,
            style,
            forwardRef,
            getValueLength,
            maxLength,
            minLength,
            showClear,
            borderless,
            autoFocus,
            ...rest
        } = this.props;
        const { isFocus, value, minLength: stateMinLength } = this.state;
        const wrapperCls = cls(className, `${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-borderless`]: borderless,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-${validateStatus}`]: Boolean(validateStatus),
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-focus`]: isFocus,
            // [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-resize`]: !autosize && resize,
        });
        // const ref = this.props.forwardRef || this.textAreaRef;
        const itemCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-autosize`]: isObject(autosize) ? isUndefined(autosize?.maxRows) : autosize,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-showClear`]: showClear,
        });
        const itemProps = {
            ...omit(rest, 'insetLabel', 'insetLabelId', 'getValueLength', 'onClear', 'showClear', 'disabledEnterStartNewLine'),
            autoFocus: autoFocus || this.props['autofocus'],
            className: itemCls,
            disabled,
            readOnly: readonly,
            placeholder: !placeholder ? null : placeholder,
            onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleChange(e.target.value, e),
            onFocus: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleFocus(e),
            onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleBlur(e.nativeEvent),
            onKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleKeyDown(e),
            value: value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value,
            onCompositionStart: this.foundation.handleCompositionStart,
            onCompositionEnd: this.foundation.handleCompositionEnd,
            onCompositionUpdate: this.foundation.handleCompositionUpdate,
        };
        if (!isFunction(getValueLength)) {
            (itemProps as any).maxLength = maxLength;
        }
        if (stateMinLength) {
            (itemProps as any).minLength = stateMinLength;
        }

        return (
            <div
                className={wrapperCls}
                style={style}
                onMouseEnter={e => this.foundation.handleMouseEnter(e)}
                onMouseLeave={e => this.foundation.handleMouseLeave(e)}
            >
                {autosize ? (
                    <ResizeObserver onResize={this.throttledResizeTextarea}>
                        <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                    </ResizeObserver>
                ) : (
                    <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                )}
                {this.renderClearBtn()}
                {this.renderCounter()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

const ForwardTextarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, Omit<TextAreaProps, 'forwardRef'>>((props, ref) => (
    <TextArea {...props} forwardRef={ref} />
));

export default ForwardTextarea;

        }

import cls from 'classnames';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import TextAreaFoundation from '@douyinfe/semi-foundation/input/textareaFoundation';
import { cssClasses } from '@douyinfe/semi-foundation/input/constants';
import BaseComponent, { ValidateStatus } from '../_base/baseComponent';
import '@douyinfe/semi-foundation/input/textarea.scss';
import { noop, omit, isFunction, isUndefined, isObject, throttle } from 'lodash';
import type { DebouncedFunc } from 'lodash';
import { IconClear } from '@douyinfe/semi-icons';
import ResizeObserver from '../resizeObserver';

const prefixCls = cssClasses.PREFIX;

type OmitTextareaAttr =
    | 'onChange'
    | 'onInput'
    | 'prefix'
    | 'size'
    | 'onFocus'
    | 'onBlur'
    | 'onKeyDown'
    | 'onKeyPress'
    | 'onKeyUp'
    | 'onResize';

export type AutosizeRow = {
    minRows?: number;
    maxRows?: number
};

export interface TextAreaProps extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, OmitTextareaAttr> {
    autosize?: boolean | AutosizeRow;
    borderless?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    value?: string;
    rows?: number;
    cols?: number;
    maxCount?: number;
    validateStatus?: ValidateStatus;
    defaultValue?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readonly?: boolean;
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    showCounter?: boolean;
    showClear?: boolean;
    onClear?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onChange?: (value: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onBlur?: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onFocus?: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onInput?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyDown?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyUp?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onKeyPress?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onEnterPress?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onPressEnter?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
    onResize?: (data: { height: number }) => void;
    getValueLength?: (value: string) => number;
    forwardRef?: ((instance: HTMLTextAreaElement) => void) | React.MutableRefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement> | null;
    /* Inner params for TextArea, Chat use it, 。
       Used to disable line breaks by pressing the enter key。
       Press enter + shift at the same time can start new line.
    */
    disabledEnterStartNewLine?: boolean
}

export interface TextAreaState {
    value: string;
    isFocus: boolean;
    isHover: boolean;
    height: number;
    minLength: number;
    cachedValue?: string
}

class TextArea extends BaseComponent<TextAreaProps, TextAreaState> {
    static propTypes = {
        autosize: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.bool, PropTypes.object]),
        borderless: PropTypes.bool,
        placeholder: PropTypes.string,
        value: PropTypes.string,
        rows: PropTypes.number,
        cols: PropTypes.number,
        maxCount: PropTypes.number,
        onEnterPress: PropTypes.func,
        validateStatus: PropTypes.string,
        className: PropTypes.string,
        style: PropTypes.object,
        showClear: PropTypes.bool,
        onClear: PropTypes.func,
        onResize: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionStart: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionEnd: PropTypes.func,
        onCompositionUpdate: PropTypes.func,
        getValueLength: PropTypes.func,
        disabledEnterStartNewLine: PropTypes.bool,
        // TODO
        // resize: PropTypes.bool,
    };

    static defaultProps = {
        autosize: false,
        borderless: false,
        rows: 4,
        cols: 20,
        showCounter: false,
        showClear: false,
        onEnterPress: noop,
        onChange: noop,
        onBlur: noop,
        onFocus: noop,
        onKeyDown: noop,
        onResize: noop,
        onClear: noop,
        onCompositionStart: noop,
        onCompositionEnd: noop,
        onCompositionUpdate: noop,
        // resize: false,
    };

    focusing: boolean;
    libRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>;
    foundation: TextAreaFoundation;
    throttledResizeTextarea: DebouncedFunc<typeof this.foundation.resizeTextarea>;

    constructor(props: TextAreaProps) {
        super(props);
        const initValue = 'value' in props ? props.value : props.defaultValue;
        this.state = {
            value: initValue,
            isFocus: false,
            isHover: false,
            height: 0,
            minLength: props.minLength,
            cachedValue: props.value,
        };
        this.focusing = false;
        this.foundation = new TextAreaFoundation(this.adapter);

        this.libRef = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();
        this.throttledResizeTextarea = throttle(this.foundation.resizeTextarea, 10);
    }

    get adapter() {
        return {
            ...super.adapter,
            setValue: (value: string) =>
                this.setState({ value }, () => {
                    if (this.props.autosize) {
                        this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
                    }
                }),
            getRef: () => this.libRef.current,
            toggleFocusing: (focusing: boolean) => this.setState({ isFocus: focusing }),
            toggleHovering: (hovering: boolean) => this.setState({ isHover: hovering }),
            notifyChange: (val: string, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onChange(val, e);
            },
            notifyClear: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onClear(e),
            notifyBlur: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onBlur(e),
            notifyFocus: (val: string, e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onFocus(e),
            notifyKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onKeyDown(e);
            },
            notifyHeightUpdate: (height: number) => {
                this.setState({ height });
                this.props.onResize({ height });
            },
            notifyPressEnter: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
                this.props.onEnterPress && this.props.onEnterPress(e);
            },
            notifyCompositionStart: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionStart(e),
            notifyCompositionEnd: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionEnd(e),
            notifyCompositionUpdate: (e: React.CompositionEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.props.onCompositionUpdate(e),
            setMinLength: (minLength: number) => this.setState({ minLength }),
        };
    }

    static getDerivedStateFromProps(props: TextAreaProps, state: TextAreaState) {
        const willUpdateStates: Partial<TextAreaState> = {};

        if (props.value !== state.cachedValue) {
            willUpdateStates.value = props.value;
            willUpdateStates.cachedValue = props.value;
        }

        return willUpdateStates;
    }

    componentWillUnmount(): void {
        if (this.throttledResizeTextarea) {
            this.throttledResizeTextarea?.cancel?.();
            this.throttledResizeTextarea = null;
        }
    }

    componentDidUpdate(prevProps: TextAreaProps, prevState: TextAreaState) {
        if (
            (this.props.value !== prevProps.value || this.props.placeholder !== prevProps.placeholder) &&
            this.props.autosize
        ) {
            this.foundation.resizeTextarea();
        }
    }

    handleClear = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        this.foundation.handleClear(e);
    };

    renderClearBtn() {
        const { showClear } = this.props;
        const displayClearBtn = this.foundation.isAllowClear();
        const clearCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-clearbtn`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-clearbtn-hidden`]: !displayClearBtn,
        });
        if (showClear) {
            return (
                // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events,jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions
                <div className={clearCls} onClick={this.handleClear}>
                    <IconClear />
                </div>
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    renderCounter() {
        let counter: React.ReactNode, current: number, total: number, countCls: string;
        const { showCounter, maxCount, getValueLength } = this.props;
        if (showCounter || maxCount) {
            const { value } = this.state;
            // eslint-disable-next-line no-nested-ternary
            current = value ? (isFunction(getValueLength) ? getValueLength(value) : value.length) : 0;
            total = maxCount || null;
            countCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter`, {
                [`${prefixCls}-textarea-counter-exceed`]: current > total,
            });
            counter = (
                <div className={countCls}>
                    {current}
                    {total ? '/' : null}
                    {total}
                </div>
            );
        } else {
            counter = null;
        }
        return counter;
    }

    setRef = (node: HTMLTextAreaElement) => {
        (this.libRef as any).current = node;
        const { forwardRef } = this.props;
        if (typeof forwardRef === 'function') {
            forwardRef(node);
        } else if (forwardRef && typeof forwardRef === 'object') {
            forwardRef.current = node;
        }
    };

    render() {
        const {
            autosize,
            placeholder,
            onEnterPress,
            onResize,
            // resize,
            disabled,
            readonly,
            className,
            showCounter,
            validateStatus,
            maxCount,
            defaultValue,
            style,
            forwardRef,
            getValueLength,
            maxLength,
            minLength,
            showClear,
            borderless,
            autoFocus,
            ...rest
        } = this.props;
        const { isFocus, value, minLength: stateMinLength } = this.state;
        const wrapperCls = cls(className, `${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-borderless`]: borderless,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-${validateStatus}`]: Boolean(validateStatus),
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-focus`]: isFocus,
            // [`${prefixCls}-textarea-wrapper-resize`]: !autosize && resize,
        });
        // const ref = this.props.forwardRef || this.textAreaRef;
        const itemCls = cls(`${prefixCls}-textarea`, {
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-disabled`]: disabled,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-readonly`]: readonly,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-autosize`]: isObject(autosize) ? isUndefined(autosize?.maxRows) : autosize,
            [`${prefixCls}-textarea-showClear`]: showClear,
        });
        const itemProps = {
            ...omit(rest, 'insetLabel', 'insetLabelId', 'getValueLength', 'onClear', 'showClear', 'disabledEnterStartNewLine'),
            autoFocus: autoFocus || this.props['autofocus'],
            className: itemCls,
            disabled,
            readOnly: readonly,
            placeholder: !placeholder ? null : placeholder,
            onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleChange(e.target.value, e),
            onFocus: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleFocus(e),
            onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleBlur(e.nativeEvent),
            onKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => this.foundation.handleKeyDown(e),
            value: value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value,
            onCompositionStart: this.foundation.handleCompositionStart,
            onCompositionEnd: this.foundation.handleCompositionEnd,
            onCompositionUpdate: this.foundation.handleCompositionUpdate,
        };
        if (!isFunction(getValueLength)) {
            (itemProps as any).maxLength = maxLength;
        }
        if (stateMinLength) {
            (itemProps as any).minLength = stateMinLength;
        }

        return (
            <div
                className={wrapperCls}
                style={style}
                onMouseEnter={e => this.foundation.handleMouseEnter(e)}
                onMouseLeave={e => this.foundation.handleMouseLeave(e)}
            >
                {autosize ? (
                    <ResizeObserver onResize={this.throttledResizeTextarea}>
                        <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                    </ResizeObserver>
                ) : (
                    <textarea {...itemProps} ref={this.setRef} />
                )}
                {this.renderClearBtn()}
                {this.renderCounter()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

            }

            color: $color-input_warning-border-focus;
        }
    }

}

框架无关的逻辑代码在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker 下，\n    token 定义的文件在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker/variables.scss,\n    样式文件通常在 packages/semi-foundation/timePicker/timepicker.scss,\n    jest单测文件在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker/__test__\n    storybook 文件在 packages/semi-ui/timePicker/_story 下\n\n### Design token 问题注意事项\n放置 scss token 的文件是 packages/semi-foundation/[component_name（驼峰命名）]/variables.scss，有以下规则\n- token 是按照 Category 分块放置的，Category 有 Color，Spacing，Radius，Font，Width/Height 等，新增加的 token 放在对应的块中\n- token 是按照 [Category]-[Module]-[Type]-[Status] 进行命名的，Category 是类别，module 是组件名称及具体的信息，Type 是类型，Status 是状态。\n  e.g: $color-tooltip_arrow-icon-default， $width-popover_title-border，\n- token 在variables.scss 中的格式必须按照固定格式为： \n  ```\n  [token 名称]: [value]; //[注释]\n  ```\n- 不要使用在 token 的 value 中使用 !default。\n- 在组件中只能定义组件级别的 token，禁止定义全局级别的 token\n- variable.scss 中定义的 scss token 仅能够在组件的 scss 文件中使用，禁止在 tsx/ts/js/jsx 类型文件中使用\n- 如果是新增加 token 需求，那么考虑是否在保留原有的 token 基础上，增加必要的 token 完成需求\n- 对于新增加的 token，如果 需求文档 中没有明确提及对应的值是什么，充分分析代码，推断出合理的值，并输出到 variable.scss 中\n\n### 修改 scss(非 variable.scss 文件) 注意事项\n- 使用 $prefix 作为全局样式前缀变量，不要硬编码前缀\n- scss 文件文件开头通常使用 $module 定义当前组件的样式前缀：$module: #{$prefix}-[组件名], 善用该变量，不要硬编码前缀\n- scss 文件中不允许通过 !important 设置样式\n\n### 修改 ts/tsx 文件注意事项\n- 尽量不要通过 style 标签设置样式，能通过 scss 文件设置的样式，尽量通过 scss 文件设置，仅在无法通过 scss 文件设置的样式，才通过 style 标签设置样式\n\n# 注意\n- 始终使用中文回复，需要搜索时，始终使用英文执行。\n\n\n以下是需求文档内容\n<rfc_content>\n# RFC: TextArea 组件行号功能技术方案\n\n## 1. 需求背景\n\n根据 issue，TextArea 组件需新增「行号显示」功能，具体要求：\n\n- 新增 `showLineNumber: boolean` 控制是否显示行号。\n- 新增 `lineNumberStart: number` 控制起始行号（默认 1）。\n- 新增 `lineNumberClassName: string` 实现自定义行号栏 class。\n- 新增 `lineNumberStyle: CSSProperties` 支持行号栏自定义样式。\n- 行号栏要和正文内容滚动同步，无延迟。\n- 行号样式、布局需支持复写和半定制，并遵循 Semi Design 既有风格。\n- 需考虑合理 token 拓展和样式适配。\n\n## 2. 实现方案\n\n### 2.1 文件改动路径说明\n\n- **组件逻辑与 API**：  \n  - `packages/semi-ui/input/textarea.tsx`\n- **样式结构**：  \n  - `packages/semi-foundation/input/textarea.scss`\n- **token 定义**（如需新增）：  \n  - `packages/semi-foundation/input/variables.scss`\n\n---\n\n### 2.2 props & 类型拓展\n\n#### 修改（新增）TextAreaProps 类型声明\n```typescript\nexport interface TextAreaProps extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, OmitTextareaAttr> {\n    ...\n    showLineNumber?: boolean;\n    lineNumberStart?: number;\n    lineNumberClassName?: string;\n    lineNumberStyle?: React.CSSProperties;\n}\n```\n- 用于支持行号可选开关、起始编号、样式定制。\n\n#### 新增（并导出复用）行号相关类型\n```typescript\nexport interface TextAreaLineNumberProps {\n    lineNumberStart: number;\n    linesCount: number;\n    className?: string;\n    style?: React.CSSProperties;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2.3 UI 结构调整与业务逻辑\n\n#### 组件结构调整（textarea.tsx）\n\n- **渲染结构**须变为：  \n  父容器横向 flex → 左侧行为号栏（自定义类名和 style），右侧为 textarea 原核心区。\n- 可复用 wrapper 样式，行号区与 textarea 在同一滚动上下文下。\n- 行号栏内容需根据 value（自动换行/rows）& lineNumberStart 生成对应数组、动态渲染（如 `<div>1</div><div>2</div>`...）。\n- 行号栏及 textarea 区域需 scroll 事件联动：  \n  - 行号栏 scrollTop/scrollLeft 要跟随 textarea 内容同步，监听 textarea onScroll 并同步对应 DOM。  \n\n#### 拟新增/修改主要函数\n\n- **渲染行号栏**  \n```typescript\nprivate renderLineNumberBar(): React.ReactNode\n// 使用: 根据 value、rows、lineNumberStart 以及可选托管函数生成行号列表，内联自定义 className、style\n```\n\n- **滚动同步处理**  \n```typescript\nprivate handleSyncScroll(e: React.UIEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>)\n/*\n  1. 在 textarea 的 onScroll 事件回调里同步 lineNumberBar 的 scrollTop，保证行号栏与内容同步滚动。\n  2. 若行号栏采用 position: sticky 或 absolute，也需设置 scrollTop 或 translateY。\n*/\n```\n\n#### 组件主渲染方法调整\n- 在 render 内，根据 `showLineNumber` 判断是否渲染行号栏结构，并适配样式。行号栏与主区同级，flex 布局，行号栏宽度可写死变量或加 token 定制。\n\n---\n\n### 2.4 样式方案\n\n#### SCSS 结构新增\n`packages/semi-foundation/input/textarea.scss`\n- 新增：`.#{$module}-textarea-lineNumberBar` 类，支持灵活宽度、文本右对齐、颜色 token 适配。\n- 若无适配 token，建议在 `variables.scss` 新增 token：\n  - $width-input_textarea-lineNumberBar: 32px; // 行号栏宽度\n  - $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-bg: var(--semi-color-fill-0); // 行号栏背景\n  - $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-text: var(--semi-color-text-2); // 行号栏文字色\n  - $spacing-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-right: 8px; // 行号栏与 textarea 内容分割的间距\n\n```scss\n.#{$module}-textarea-lineNumberBar {\n  position: absolute;\n  left: 0;\n  top: 0;\n  width: $width-input_textarea-lineNumberBar;\n  height: 100%;\n  background: $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-bg;\n  color: $color-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-text;\n  text-align: right;\n  padding-right: $spacing-input_textarea-lineNumberBar-right;\n  box-sizing: border-box;\n  user-select: none;\n  font-family: inherit;\n  font-size: inherit;\n  /* 支持传入自定义行号 class & style */\n}\n```\n- 在原 wrapper 外层加 position:relative，使行号栏和 textarea 共存（行号栏可绝对定位或采用 flex 布局）。\n\n---\n\n### 2.5 token 新增建议\n\n若需支持行号栏样式 token，建议在\n`packages/semi-foundation/input/variables.scss`
